saw_head: Your best customers already own a pair.
saw_l1: Allbirds sells shoes and apparel for men and women, with new colours and styles landing through the year. A customer who bought once has every reason to buy again, if they hear about it.
saw_l2: The customers from the last two years who have not ordered since, the browsers who never checked out and the subscribers who stopped opening are all still in your Klaviyo account.
saw_turn: The segment reactivation system maps those groups in the first three days and puts win-back, browse and cart flows plus weekly launch campaigns in front of them, so the next drop sells to people who already trust the brand.
